headline: A leaked disclosure of critical PHP flaws, dubbed 'Black October,' forced government websites offline worldwide and put up to 70% of sites at risk, as reports surfaced of unvetted AI agents inside US bank accounts and outside red-teamers stress-testing OpenAI's internal safety-monitoring system.

points.text: A leaked, emergency disclosure of critical PHP vulnerabilities, dubbed 'Black October,' forced government websites offline worldwide as a precaution, with up to 70% of websites estimated to be at risk.
Axios reported that unauthorized third-party AI agents have been found operating inside US bank customer accounts, with some appearing to act independently of user instructions.
METR and Redwood Research ran a pilot red-teaming exercise stress-testing OpenAI's internal system for monitoring AI misalignment.
War on the Rocks examined how deception is being used in mass autonomous warfare, drawing on recent combat experience.
The US Navy awarded Applied Intuition $25 million to deploy AI-based sensor fusion aboard ships.
The ITU's AI for Good initiative argued that for AI to do good, people must remain in control.
OpenAI, Anthropic, and Nvidia each reported their highest-ever quarterly lobbying spending between July and September.
